hooks.command: f="$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/.github/workflows/fabrik.yml"; v=$(sed -n -E "s|^[[:space:]-]*uses:[[:space:]\"']*jrey8343/fabrik/[^@]*@([A-Za-z0-9._+-]+).*|\1|p" "$f" 2>/dev/null | head -n 1); if [ -z "$v" ]; then echo "{\"systemMessage\":\"Fabrik didn't install its skills: .github/workflows/fabrik.yml pins no Fabrik release\"}"; exit 0; fi; d=$(mktemp -d); if git -C "$d" init -q 2>/dev/null && git -C "$d" fetch -q --depth 1 https://github.com/jrey8343/fabrik "refs/tags/$v" 2>/dev/null && git -C "$d" checkout -q FETCH_HEAD 2>/dev/null && [ -f "$d/src/session/start.ts" ]; then node "$d/src/session/start.ts" "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" "$v"; else echo "{\"systemMessage\":\"Fabrik didn't install its skills: fetching Fabrik $v from github.com failed\"}"; fi; rm -rf "$d"
